mapper.select: SELECT r.id AS memory_id, r.member_id AS author_id, m.nickname AS author_nickname, s.id AS spot_id, s.name AS spot_name, r.latitude AS latitude, r.longitude AS longitude, r.visited_date AS visited_date, r.nights AS nights, r.content AS content, r.visibility AS visibility, r.created_at AS created_at, r.updated_at AS updated_at FROM memory r JOIN member m ON m.id = r.member_id LEFT JOIN spot s ON s.id = r.spot_id AND s.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE r.id = #{memoryId}

SELECT r.id AS memory_id, s.id AS spot_id, s.name AS spot_name, r.latitude AS latitude, r.longitude AS longitude, r.visited_date AS visited_date, r.nights AS nights, LEFT(r.content, 100) AS excerpt, r.visibility AS visibility, (SELECT i.object_key FROM memory_image i WHERE i.memory_id = r.id ORDER BY i.display_order LIMIT 1) AS thumbnail_key, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM memory_image i2 WHERE i2.memory_id = r.id) AS image_count, r.created_at AS created_at FROM memory r LEFT JOIN spot s ON s.id = r.spot_id AND s.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE r.member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY r.visited_date DESC, r.id DESC
